notRegistered.title: This device isn't registered
notRegistered.body: The cashier only works on devices activated for {{outlet}}. Ask a Manager to sign in on this device to activate it.
notRegistered.manager: Name this device, then activate it as one of {{outlet}}'s cashiers. Its code goes into every receipt number it makes.

revoked.title: This device was revoked
revoked.body: This device can't sell anymore. Ask a Manager to activate it again.
revoked.manager: This device can't sell anymore. Activate it again as a new device: name it, then activate it.

device.name: Device name
device.nameHint: For example Front counter. At most 50 characters.

menu.heading: Choose menu
menu.none: No menus on sale yet. A Manager adds them on the Menu page.

cart.title: Detail Items
cart.empty: No order yet. Choose a menu to start.
cart.locked: The last sale hasn't been answered. Settle it before changing the order.
cart.tooMuch: An order comes to at most Rp 1,000,000,000.

pay.title: Pay in cash
pay.unknown: The server hasn't answered, so this sale may have been saved. Send it again: the same sale is never recorded twice.
pay.abandonWarning: The order can change again. Check today's orders before charging again: this sale may have been saved.

changed.unavailable: {{names}} is no longer on sale, so it was taken out of the order.
changed.stock: There isn't enough {{names}} left, so the quantity was cut.
changed.total: The outlet's tax or service charge, or the voucher's terms, changed.
changed.check: Check the order and its total, then charge again.

history.title: Today's orders
history.noMatch: No sale today has that number.

void.title: Void sale {{number}}?
void.body: The sale and its payment are cancelled, and its stock goes back. This can't be undone.

voucher.label: Voucher
voucher.minSpend: This voucher needs a subtotal of at least {{amount}}. Add to the order or remove the voucher.

tables.title: Tables
tables.intro: Pick a table to see its status, order at it, or release it once its customers have gone.
tables.empty: This outlet has no tables yet. The Manager adds them on the admin Tables page.
tables.numberMode: This outlet uses number stands: dine-in customers take a numbered stand, and the cashier types its number in Detail Items instead of picking a table.
tables.inactive: The Manager has turned this table off, so it can't be picked.
tables.scheduled: This table is scheduled off, so it can't be picked.
tables.pendingHint: The last sale has no answer yet. Settle it first in Detail Items.

release.title: Release table {{name}}?
release.body: Do this once the customers have left. The table is free again for the next ones.

pick.title: Pick a table
pick.intro: Available and occupied tables can be picked. An order more at the same table is a sale of its own.

stand.label: Stand number
stand.format: 1–10 letters, digits or hyphens, for example 12, A5 or B-3.
stand.tableDropped: This outlet now uses number stands, so table {{name}} was taken off the order. Type the number on the customer's stand.
stand.standDropped: This outlet now uses tables, so stand number {{number}} was taken off the order.
stand.nowNumber: This outlet now uses number stands. Type the number on the customer's stand.
